title: The Fox and the Goat
author: Aesop (adapted by J. H. Stickney)
summary: 狐狸掉进井里，哄山羊跳下去，又踩着山羊的背逃走。
publicDomainBasis: Aesop's fables are ancient; this retelling by J. H. Stickney was published in 1915. Published before 1923 and therefore public domain in the United States; Project Gutenberg releases it as public domain.

paragraphs.en: A FOX once happened to fall into a deep well. He tried in every way to get out, but at last began to think that it was impossible, and that he must die there, a prisoner. While he was thinking how sad that would be, a thirsty Goat came and looked down into the well, wishing that he could get some water. He soon saw the Fox.
paragraphs.zh: 有一次，一只狐狸掉进了一口深井。他想尽办法要爬出去，最后开始觉得这根本不可能，自己只能困死在那里。正当他想着这有多悲惨时，一只口渴的山羊来到井边，往下张望，想找点水喝。他很快就看见了狐狸。

paragraphs.en: “Halloo,” said the Goat, “what are you doing down there? Is the water good?”
paragraphs.zh: “喂，”山羊说，“你在下面干什么？这水好喝吗？”

paragraphs.en: “The best I ever tasted,” answered the Fox. “It is cool, and clear, and delicious. Come down and try it yourself.”
paragraphs.zh: “我喝过的最好的水，”狐狸回答，“又凉又清，美味极了。下来自己尝尝吧。”

paragraphs.en: “I will,” said the Goat, “for I am nearly dead with thirst.”
paragraphs.zh: “我这就下来，”山羊说，“我快渴死了。”

paragraphs.en: So he jumped down, and drank as much water as he wanted.
paragraphs.zh: 于是他跳了下去，想喝多少就喝多少。

paragraphs.en: “Yes,” said the Fox; “and now, if you have finished drinking, let me ask how you expect to get out of this well again.”
paragraphs.zh: “是啊，”狐狸说，“现在，如果你喝够了，我倒要问问，你打算怎么从这个井里出去？”

paragraphs.en: “Oh, I don’t know,” replied the Goat. “How do you expect to get out?”
paragraphs.zh: “唉，我不知道，”山羊回答，“你打算怎么出去？”

paragraphs.en: “That is what I have been wondering about for the last hour,” said the Fox, “and have just now thought of a good plan. If you will put your forefeet high up on the wall, I will climb up your back, and so get out, and then, of course, I can help you out.”
paragraphs.zh: “这正是我琢磨了一个钟头的事，”狐狸说，“我刚想出一个好办法。你把前蹄高高搭在井壁上，我顺着你的背爬上去，这样我就出去了，然后当然可以再帮你出去。”

paragraphs.en: “Very well,” said the Goat, who was a simple creature, “that is a good plan. How I wish I had your brains!” He put his forefeet on the wall, and the Fox easily climbed out and started to go on his way.
paragraphs.zh: “好吧，”头脑简单的山羊说，“这办法不错。我要是有你那样的脑子就好了！”他把前蹄搭在井壁上，狐狸轻而易举地爬了上去，抬脚就要走。

paragraphs.en: “Wait a moment,” called the Goat; “you forgot to help me out.”
paragraphs.zh: “等一等，”山羊喊道，“你忘了帮我出去。”

paragraphs.en: “You foolish fellow!” said the Fox, with a mocking laugh; “you ought to have thought how you would get out, before you jumped down. I fell in, but you went down of your own accord. Look before you leap next time,” and off he ran.
paragraphs.zh: “你这蠢家伙！”狐狸嘲笑着叫道，“你跳下来之前，就该想好怎么出去。我是掉进来的，你却是自己下去的。下次跳之前先看清楚。”说完他就跑了。
